name: Corn vs Soybean Carry Comparison
description: Compares term structure carry (M1/M2 - 1) between soybeans (ZS, primary) and corn (ZC, reference). Dashboard includes: summary table with current carry for each, carry spread, and % days in contango; dual line chart of ZS and ZC carry over time; carry spread (ZS - ZC) line chart; and monthly average carry bar charts for both commodities. Uses NoAdjustment + spread_depth=1 futures_continuation for both assets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN vs SOYBEAN CARRY COMPARISON DASHBOARD
# =============================================================================
#
# Primary: ZS (Soybeans) — gets candlestick page
# Reference: ZC (Corn) — loaded via reference_futures
#
# Both piped through futures_continuation with NoAdjustment + spread_depth=1.
# Carry = M1/M2 - 1: positive = backwardation, negative = contango.
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Summary table: current carry (ZS, ZC), carry spread, % days contango
#   2. Line chart: ZS & ZC carry over time
#   3. Line chart: Carry spread (ZS - ZC) over time
#   4. Bar charts: Average carry by calendar month for each commodity
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary: ZS (Soybeans) with NoAdjustment + term structure ---
src = market_data_source()()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zs_carry = zs_cont.carry

# --- Reference: ZC (Corn) via futures_continuation ---
zc_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZC')()
zc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(zc_ref.o, zc_ref.h, zc_ref.l, zc_ref.c, zc_ref.v, zc_ref.oi, zc_ref.s)

zc_carry = zc_cont.carry

# --- Carry spread: ZS minus ZC ---
carry_spread = zs_carry - zc_carry

# --- % days in contango (carry < 0) — expanding mean of boolean = proportion ---
zs_contango_pct = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zs_carry < 0)
zc_contango_pct = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(zc_carry < 0)

# --- Time index and calendar month for seasonal analysis ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Carry Snapshot
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Carry Comparison: Soybeans vs Corn',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Soybeans (ZS)', 'Corn (ZC)'],
        col_headers=['Current Carry', '% Days Contango', 'Carry Spread (ZS-ZC)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='ZS current carry (M1/M2-1)', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='% of days ZS in contango', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current carry spread ZS-ZC', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='ZC current carry (M1/M2-1)', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='% of days ZC in contango', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='(same spread value)', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot',
    order=0
)(zs_carry, zs_contango_pct, carry_spread, zc_carry, zc_contango_pct, carry_spread)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: ZS & ZC Carry Over Time
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean vs Corn Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    category='2. Carry Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Carry',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soybean (ZS) Carry', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Corn (ZC) Carry', color=Color.Amber)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zs_carry, zc_carry))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Carry Spread (ZS - ZC) Over Time
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Carry Spread: Soybeans - Corn',
    category='2. Carry Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Carry Spread (ZS - ZC)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZS - ZC Carry Spread', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(carry_spread,))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4a: Soybean Average Carry by Month
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Soybean (ZS) Avg Carry by Month',
    category='3. Seasonal Carry',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg Carry',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    order=3
)(values=zs_carry, label=month_num)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4b: Corn Average Carry by Month
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Corn (ZC) Avg Carry by Month',
    category='3. Seasonal Carry',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg Carry',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    order=4
)(values=zc_carry, label=month_num)
